text: Ranger Carellis is a blood elf located at Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman. She is one of Pustulio the Lesser's guards.
Ranger Adronis is a blood elf located at Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman. He is one of Pustulio the Lesser's guards.
Ranger Duskhaft is a blood elf located in Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman.
Ranger Fardawn is a blood elf located in Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman.
Ranger Bodine is a dwarven hunter trainer located at the Greyfang Enclave in Dalaran.
Ranger Snowdawn is a high elf located at Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman.
Ranger Marillion is a blood elf located in Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman.
Ranger Silvershadow is a blood elf located in Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman.
Randi Edwards is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Ralston Karn is a human located in Boralus Harbor in Boralus. He is also found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.

Ramao was a high elf who survived the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas. He wanted to send a letter to his wife Melena but never managed to do it as he was presumably killed when he tried to stop Prince Kael'thas and his blood elves from burning the forest. The letter survived and was later found by Brann Bronzebeard when he was exploring the Blackened Woods. He found it in a scrap of parchment in one ruin, near a blackened skeleton.
Ranger Captain Natacha is a blood elf located at the Wreck of the Hungry Riverbeast in Nazjatar.

Ranger Salissa is a member of the Farstriders and was part of a poorly conceived attack on Zeb'Sora in the Ghostlands led by Lieutenant Tomathren. Ranger Valanna then sent Ranger Lethvalin to Tranquillien and Ranger Salissa to the Farstrider Enclave for help. Captain Helios never heard back from Salissa, however, and he feared the worst.
Rannan Korren is a human located at Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. Beside him is the fellow Dragonscale Expedition member Lathos Sunband.
Ramaniel is a void elf located in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken. He is found chatting with Melinor.
Ranger's Finesse is a Marksmanship hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Rannal Dawnsong is a night elf found sitting with Zelley on a small isle in the southern part of the Emerald Dream.
Rarc is an orc armor & shield vendor located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Rartar is an orc alchemy vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Rapid Killing is a hunter talent found in the Marksmanship tree.

Rask was a loyal servant of the black dragon Sinestra, formerly known as Sintharia, during her time at Grim Batol. Furthermore Rask only truly took orders from her and was reported to have been the few figures in Grim Batol who didn't have to listen to Zendarin Windrunner. Under his master's command, Rask would capture the dragons Krasus and Kalec with a group of skardyn and a modified mageslayer. Rask was later seen after Vereesa Windrunner and her companions were ambushed by fire elementals and given the choice for them to surrender or die. After they surrendered he personally claimed Vereesa's sword as his own. When Vereesa came to the realization that Sintharia was in fact behind the eve
Raug is an orc trade goods vendor located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Raquel Deyling is a human paladin located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Rarnok is an orc located in the Town Hall of Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. Rarnok is an Emissary for the Guilds of the Horde. Once a guild achieves , Rarnok will allow players to place their guild's banners around Frostwall.

Ravael was a night elf who sought out Illidan Stormrage in Outland to fight the Burning Legion. He told Vandel that he had "lost everything," but did not elaborate further. He survived the rites to become a demon hunter, but lost control during a training duel with Vandel and assumed his demon form. Vandel killed Ravael and consumed his soul to heal his own wounds.
Raptor's Cry is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Hellcarver, Terms of Engagement (artifact trait) and Explosive Force traits.

Rasean Lightfall is a blood elf paladin located in Stratholme. He can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows. Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, he is no longer a member of the Silver Hand.
Ravaging Knuckledragger was a Pale orc located in Spires of Arak. It was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
Rattling Bones is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Bonebreaker (death knight artifact trait) and Vampiric Fangs traits.
Rasha Stonetusk is a jungle troll and commander of the Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley.
Rawrk is an orc first aid trainer located in the Razor Hill Barracks in Razor Hill in Durotar. He appears at the Kosh'harg.

Rayne is a night elf druid found near the entrance into the Fungal Vale of the Eastern Plaguelands. Prior to the Cataclysm, she was found at Light's Hope Chapel aiding druids with their Dreamwalker Raiment set.
Raven is an elite human rogue found in Zul'Farrak. Raven is and assists during the Pyramid battle, but becomes during the Sergeant Bly event.
Rayan Dawnrisen is a high elf located at the top of Xylem's Tower at Bear's Head in Azshara. Alongside him was Joy Ar'nareth.
Ravenous Dead is a death knight talent located on tier 2 of the Unholy tree.

Ravic is a high elf of Quel'Danil Lodge. He caught Lieren sneaking into the lodge and confused her with Loania. He brought her into Loania's room, to discover the real one was just inside. He got shocked, and thought Loania had duplicated herself. Shortly thereafter, Voldana arrived and dispatched him telling him she would handle the situation.
Raza'kul is a Frostwolf orc champion found in Frostwall, when the Gladiator's Sanctum is built. He gives the commander some garrison quests to kill Alliance players.

Ravencrest Mausoleum is a large tomb where Kur'talos Ravencrest was buried after he died. It features a long hallway with stone figures and a chamber with Ravencrest's posthumous throne. After the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Ravencrest mysteriously disappeared from his tomb.

Razgaji is the leader of a tribe of Zandalari troll exiles at the Scorched Sands Outpost in Vol'dun. He used to be a member of Mojambo's gang of thugs but left in the hopes of a second chance at an honest life. Shortly after an adventurer arrives at the outpost, Mojambo and his henchmons threaten the Scorched Sands Arena, and Razgaji asks the adventurer to back him up as he convinces the rival gang to leave. Mojambo complies but promises to come back and kill Razgaji. Razgaji sends the hero to assist Mugjabu and Sezahjin in order to prepare the outpost for Mojambo's attack. After the adventurer does so, they hear from Zauljin that Mojambo has hired Tongo's gang to help him in the attack on t

Ravenous Consumption is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from the Council of Blood in Castle Nathria, the P.O.S.T. Master in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, and Halondrus in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Razzlebeard is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Razorbloom in Gorgrond. He was killed by the Botani and his body will now be used to feed them.

Razor Guerra is a Forsaken rogue captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Guerra or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.

Rear Admiral Hartley is a human admiral found on the Merchant Coast of Northern Barrens. He commands The Bellipotent, flagship of the Northwatch Expeditionary Unit. He seems to be fairly clever, foreseeing that someone would try to mine his ship and moving his munitions to the shore.
Rebecca Blackman is a human food vendor located at Marshtide Watch in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Rear Admiral Zigg is an orc admiral found on a ship docked near Zan'vess during the Assault on Zan'vess. She briefs adventurers on the mission they are about to undertake.
Reagor Kennessy is a human found at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Rebecca Stirling is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Reblock was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Reanimation is an Unholy death knight PvP talent. When used, it summons a homing, exploding zombie about 20 yards away from the target in a random direction.

Rear Admiral Giggleplanks is a gnomish member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers found floating off of the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore atop an inflatable pool pony during Pirates' Day. He appears to think highly of himself and seeks to unleash his wrath upon Booty Bay, but is having trouble compelling his "stallion" to take him there. According to "Bad News" Brin, Giggleplanks is crazy and once used his "gnomish gizmos" to combine a parrot and a shark into the "ultimate pirate companion", which worked great until it talked his ear off.
Rebecca Hale is a human located at the Wayward Thicket in Drustvar. She is part of Wons' ranger team.
Rear Admiral Hainsworth is a human located at the Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.
Rebecca Lin is a human located at the Tiragarde Customs Agency in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Rebecca Carmine is a human located at Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Rebecca Barnes is a human located by the road between Fort Daelin and Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Rebkinera is a green dragon in gnome visage located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Recruit's Tunic is the starting chest for blood elf warriors.
Recruit's Vest is the starting chest for human, dwarf, gnome, night elf, and draenei warriors.
Reckless Abandon is a Fury warrior talent. It causes Rampage to change Bloodthirst and Raging Blow into Bloodbath and Crushing Blow respectively. It is an exclusive choice node with Anger Management.
Recruit Brutis is a human located at Thovas Base-Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Red-Eyed Ben is a human member of the Northsea Freebooters located at the Scalawag Point in the contested of the Howling Fjord.

Redjaw was an orc who, along with his some of his orc comrades, were tricked by the night elf Oakwidow, to head to a dwarven mining town to look for work. Upon arriving they were attacked by hordes of undead, they were eventually saved by a dwarven healer, but they didn't want to leave her with the dead, so they battled their way through the town, to the dwarf's location, only to realize that she was badly hurt, and that they were surrounded by the undead.

Redia Vaunt is a human warlock trainer located above the doorway of Jaina's Tower on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. Redia often thinks Theramore is too sweet for her tastes. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Redknuckle is a tauren pirate captain who once attacked a Stormwind ship on which Chen Stormstout happened to be.
Reddon is a character mentioned by Adjutant Tesoran as serving in the Theramore Guard. His fate is unknown.
Regnus Thundergranite is a dwarf hunter trainer located at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Regina Halloran is a human child located at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Regina Salister is a human trade goods vendor located at Tabetha's Farm deep in the Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh.
Reina Morningchill is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Refreshing Jade Wind is a Mistweaver monk talent, used to heal your nearby allies. It is an exclusive choice node with Mist Wrap.
Reignition Overdrive is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Molten Skin, Fire at Will and Blast Furnace (mage artifact trait) traits.

Reigol Valdread is a Forsaken mercenary and a member of the Hidden serving as their swordsman. He is known for his overuse of the jasmine perfume. He wears a hood over his head. He often made fun of his companions' bickering, because he is bored most of the time.
Reggy was a human located at Tarren Mill in Old Hillsbrad Foothills. He is a fisherman and seems to constantly lose his boots in the lake and one of his buddies wishes that he would not catch one.
Reginald West is a human located in the Crosswind Ferry Registrar's Office in Boralus.
Reflective Plating is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Dragon Scales, Dragon Skin, and Thunder Crash traits.

Rekshak was an orc belonging to the Warsong clan. He was the leader of the group of orcs that Thrall encountered while searching for Grom Hellscream. The group had captured a human child, but Grom, fearing that the child's parents would track them down, ordered Rekshak to take it back to the village unharmed. His status is unknown.
Rek Moshfang is an orc trade goods vendor located at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.
Reislek's Ghost is a human ghost located at Ravenholdt in Hillsbrad Foothills. He is part of the source of Survivor's Bag of Coins.
Relastrasza is a red dragon located at Skytop Observatory in the Waking Shores.

Relfthra was an elder high elf and a member of the Order of Tirisfal when Aegwynn was chosen as Guardian. After Aegwynn banished the demon Zmodlor to the Nether, Aegwynn was met with criticism from Relfthra, who, along with Erbag the gnome, claimed she had rushed in to counter the threat from Zmodlor without thinking of possible greater risks to the world. Years later, Aegwynn admitted that she was an "arrogant brat" at the time, but Relfthra was "such a stick in the mud". It is likely that Relfthra still lived during the time of the council's downfall, as he was present when Aegwynn went against the council to choose her own successor, and died some time afterwards. Valeera Sanguinar is a d
Remen Marcot is a human located in the cellar of the Lion's Pride Inn of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, along with Maximillian Crowe and Cylina Darkheart.
Relga is an orc drink vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
Nyrisse is a night elf drink vendor located at Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.
Relissa is a blood elf child found in Zul'Aman. She has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.
Relentless Onslaught is a conduit for havoc demon hunters. It drops from Domina Venomblade in Plaguefall and Rygelon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Relixigos was a blue dragon who was slain by the Burning Legion. His name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Innkeeper Renee Lauer is a Forsaken innkeeper and general goods vendor located inside an inn in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Before the Cataclysm, she was located inside Gallows' End Tavern.
Rendel Firetongue is a Wildhammer dwarf of the Earthen Ring located in the Kelp'thar Forest of Vashj'ir. He is focused on removing the naga forces within the forest.
Rendrol Goreslash is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Rensar Greathoof is a night elf located at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
Renford is a human. He is presumably the author of Renford's Letter.
Renten Plaguebringer is a human located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Resourcefulness is a 3 rank hunter talent in the Survival tree.
Resilient Infection is a death knight talent in the Unholy tree.
Researcher Tulius is a human located in the Hall of the Guardian after researching Arcane Divination upgrade research. She provides the work order for the Seal of Broken Fate.

Archeus is the sword of Morgan Ladimore, a soldier from Darkshire who fought for the Alliance in Lordaeron. After the death of Uther the Lightbringer, he returned to Darkshire to find his family dead, and he subsequently went mad, eventually killing a group of cemetery custodians who came to investigate. Ladimore committed suicide and returned as the beast Mor'Ladim, who haunted the cemetery of Raven Hill. He was slain by an adventurer working on behalf of Darkshire's Night Watch. His only surviving daughter, Sarah Ladimore, then asked the adventurer to deliver her ring to her father's grave outside of Raven Hill, to let him know that she was still alive. Ladimore's spirit gave his sword to
Restoral is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Revival.

Revenge is a Protection warrior talent. It is a high-damage melee attack that deals damage to all enemies in front of the warrior. Dodging or parrying an attack will cause the next Revenge to be free.

Reyna Stonebranch is a dwarf herbalism trainer located in the shop Ironforge Physician, in the southern section of the Great Forge in Ironforge. Following the instructions from the tablet from Ulduar, Reyna created the liquid that was intended for Magni to communicate with Azeroth, but instead he was turned into diamond.

Revith One-Ear is a Dark Iron dwarf rogue and mage. He is a particularly sadistic Dark Iron. Revith was next in line to become chieftain, after the death of the former chieftain Bakthet, before M’Nath Pikesplitter (Rumholt Thunderaxe) showed up. Revith did not particularly want to be chieftain, so he harbored no resentment toward the new arrival. In fact, M’Nath slew several troggs before they ransacked Revith’s personal treasury, so the Dark Iron respected the new chief. Since the trogg attack, Revith carries all his personal belongings with him. Revith is cruel, cunning and selfish. He savors bloodshed so long as it does not put him in danger. He is particularly fond of his rings of ghostl

Revil Kost is a human priest of the Holy Light. His family was slaughtered by the worgen, and Revil held on to an old doll as a memento for a time. He believes the Light guides his life and is extremely devout in his faith but is not as sympathetic as other priests and has a surly demeanor: for example, refusing to heal a soldier who got stabbed in an argument over food in order to teach him a moral lesson and also chiding him for his selfishness. Many have claimed him to be the angriest priest they've ever met.
Reynah Firecaster was a blood elf mage who, with Barnabas Grell attempted to avenge their loved ones who were killed by the Scarlet Crusade.
Reuben was a human from Lordaeron who was supposed to receive a final letter to his friend Leagrem, during the Third War. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Reverence is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Holy Hands, Focus in the Light and Words of Healing traits.
Reynas is a human ghost located in the Forgotten Cove in Stormsong Valley.
Revolving Blades is an Azerite trait available to Havoc demon hunters.
Revnar Thunderale is a dwarf located at Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Revitalizing Prayers is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sanctified Prayers.
Rhag Garmason is a dwarf located at Dun Modr in the Wetlands.
Rifleman Middlecamp is a dwarf rifleman found at a small camp east of the entrance to Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
Rifleman Wheeler is a dwarf rifleman found at a small camp east of the entrance to Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
Rhonsus is a human ghost found in Kirin'Var Village of Netherstorm.
Richard Maschner is a human blacksmith vendor located at the sea base of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

Rhastion is a member of the Brazilian Portuguese language CM team on WoW, Starcraft 2 and Diablo 3 Brazilian forums. He was the first CM for Brazilian community. [http://us.battle.net/wow/pt/search?f=post&a=Rhastion&sort=time Most Recent posts on Brazilian World of Warcraft forum]

Rifthunter Yoske is an orc hunter captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Yoske or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Ribchewer is an orc vendor and stable master located at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond. He also appears as one of the traders in the Frostwall's Trading Post.
Rhys Carrington is a human located at Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. He is also present during the Legion Assaults.
Rhol Landers is a human located in Obsidian Forest in the Twilight Highlands.
Rhonda is a human located at the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle, practicing her skills on a Training Bag.

Rin Longbrow was the wife of Zhu Longbrow, the famous pandaren hunter who founded the Zhu Province and Zhu's Watch. Together, Zhu, Rin and and their son Po carved out and settled a corner of the wilds in order to create safe passage through the Krasarang Wilds. Like her husband and son, Rin was a formidable hunter in her own right. One of the three memorial bonfires which line the southwestern border of the Zhu Province and discourage beasts from wandering out of the wilds is named after her.

Riglo is an orc wolf master who had participated in the glut of Mak'Rogahn resulting from peaceful times. One Mak'Rogahn was against an armorer he had insulted, which he won in a matter of minutes with a hard punch in the armorer's temple. It's unknown where he is at the moment.
Rike Stillbreath is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Riley Sullivander is a human located at Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Rin is a monk. As Emperor Shaohao once did, she watches over the rest of Pandaria.
Rigid Carapace is an Azerite trait available to Vengeance demon hunters.

Rikter Hogsnozzle was a trade prince of the Bilgewater Cartel. He once cost his rival trade prince Klaxz Boompowder "the rocket boot deal of a lifetime", and Klaxz considered Hogsnozzle a "deadbeat". Hogsnozzle's funeral was known as "the biggest shindig of the year" and was attended by thousands of goblins, ranging from his cartel's family bosses to common shop owners. As tradition dictated, his coffin (made from a metal shipping container) was filled with riches and burial gifts, to the point that it didn't budge when it was time to place it in the burial site and the Bilgewater Cartel had to bring in cranes to move it. It was during Hogsnozzle's funeral that Klaxz attracted the attention
Risera is a green dragon stable master, in the guise of a night elf, located inside the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
Rising Winds is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Dark Skies, Death Art, and Good Karma (artifact trait) traits.
Rising Mist is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Tear of Morning.
Ritualist Kuhlrath is an orc located at the Spirit Woods in .

Rivan is a bakar spirit standing next to Talis in the ruined structure in the center of the Sylvan Glade in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Both he and Talis are normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening.
Robert Aebischer was a human armor vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He is nowhere to be found after the destruction of Southshore.

Roanauk Icemist is the leader of the taunka in Northrend. At the time of the war against the Lich King, a fissure into Azjol-Nerub opened near Icemist Village, and Scourge nerubians poured out. They killed most of the taunka and captured Roanauk. He was then imprisoned in the ruins of the capital by the undead under the orders of Under-King Anub'et'kan. Wrapped in foul sorcery, he was poked with sticks for a few weeks, until adventurers of the Horde freed him. For their help, Roanauk accepted for the Icemist tribe and the Taunka'le Refugees to be inducted into the Horde.
Robert Pierce is a human found in his shop, Pierce's Pistols, in Old Stratholme. He is also seen in the Deaths of Chromie.
Rob Bridenbecker is a human located at Elwynn Forest. He can be found at his home near Goldshire, with his family.
Robert was a human of the local populace in Vandermar Village. He was seen punching with in the chapter 1 of the Undead Campaign. They both died during ' "visit" to the village.
Robin Fredericksen is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Roan Berthold is a human located on the Old Drust Road above Southwind Station in Tiragarde Sound, next to Beetle and two Fizzsprings Rental Horses. If the player reaches Berthold while riding the Guardian of the Spring, he will spawn a Hay Covered Chest for them to loot.
Rob is a human located at the Tradewinds Food Court in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Robert Sevilla (shortened as Rob Sevilla) is a senior character artist who is currently working at Blizzard Entertainment. He contributed to .

Robe-Robber Robert is a human located in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena. He is one of the combatants that the player may fight, more specifically a Rank 6 opponent. One of the more comical foes, he still carries a nasty trick up his sleeve... Or yours! As his name suggests, Robert attempts to disrobe your character during the battle. Done enough times, your character will end up in their underwear, their shame displayed for all to see. This can be very dangerous, as being stripped will heavily increase the damage you incur. On the other hand, you can turn the tables on the pernicious pickpocket and beat him at his own game!
Roaring Fire is a conduit for vengeance demon hunters. It drops from Executor Tarvold in the Sanguine Depths and Painsmith Raznal in the Sanctum of Domination.
Rogvar is an orc alchemy trainer located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Rohok is an orc master blacksmithing trainer and vendor located at Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Rogg is an orc blacksmithing trainer located inside Naros' Armory in Orgrimmar. He keeps mindlessly using his hammer against the anvil. Before the Cataclysm, he was found near Orgrimmar General Store. He can also be seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was standing at the entrance of the armory.

Rogoc is an orc located at the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar. He sells Bloodthirsty Gladiator set items in exchange for Mark of Honor, and previously sold honor trade goods. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Advisor Willington.
Roiling Blood is a death knight talent, available at level 56.
Roggo Harlbarrow is a dwarf located at Dun Modr in the Wetlands. He was unable to contact dwarven forces when the Dark Irons took control of Thandol Span.
Rok'kal is an orc fishing at the lake in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. Rok'kal was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Rohar was a high elf mage at Nallorath's father court and a member of the Council of Tirisfal 2,600 years before the First War. He battled against Kathra'natir who stole the Amulet of Waters.
Rockwell was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Rohana Firefang was an orc located on the Horde gunship above the the Wound in Silithus. She provided a wyvern back to the Horde base at Southwind Village.
Rodney is a human found sleeping in his camp in the hills west of Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.
Rohaka Tuskmaul is an orc located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Rocky Dustbeard is a dwarf located in the Waking Shores. He can be found with Stella Stargazer next to a Crashed Gyrocopter. They are under attack by Turbulent Gusts.
Rocko Dynamite is a human. He reuses one of the models of Algerson Lumberjacks.

Rokhan (pronounced ROH-kawn) is a veteran shadow hunter of the Darkspear tribe, said by Thrall himself to be the Horde's best scout. After the Third War, he assisted Rexxar to halt Admiral Proudmoore's campaign and notably participated in the war in the alternate Draenor. After the death of Vol'jin, he was considered a potential public face for the Darkspear trolls, though they had not found a new leader yet. Rokhan became instrumental to the winning over of the Zandalari Empire to ally with the Horde, becoming close friends with the princess, and later queen, Talanji. When the Horde became divided between Varok Saurfang's revolutionaries and Sylvanas Windrunner's loyalists, Rokhan stood by
Rorelien is a night elf master herbalism trainer located in Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. She's found in the tower in Honor Hold in an alcove on the ground floor.
Rom was a dwarf who helped the Alliance of Lordaeron to save the dragonqueen Alexstrasza.
Rol'tharak was a night elf officer under the command of Kur'talos Ravencrest.
Rosina Rivet is a dwarf blacksmithing trainer found in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Rosemary Bovard is a human Master leatherworking trainer located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Ronald Anderson is a human stable master located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

Rokul is an orc who worked for Rehgar Earthfury and traveled with his caravan. After the death and funeral of Bloodeye Redfist, he and Spiketooth led the caravan back to Orgrimmar through the Bladefist Bay where they found an amnesiac human man. The man woke up only to battle against a crocolisk. Rokul bet 20 silver with Spiketooth on the human. With the help of Rehgar, the human was able to defeat the crocolisk but eventually he was taken as a gladiator.
Rook Hawkfist is a night elf located in the Silver Covenant Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament.
Rollo Sureshot is a dwarf found at the Silver Covenant Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. He was present during Death Rising.

Role Dreuger is a human found in Darkshire's town hall in Duskwood. He is the Deputy Mayor to Lord Ello Ebonlocke and a member of the Council of Darkshire. Around the time of the Cataclysm, the Twilight's Hammer cult tried to recruit the citizens of Darkshire with their apocalyptic notes. As such, Dreuger notified Lord Ello Ebonlocke of the situation and placed the Night Watch on high alert. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the Council alongside some members of the Night Watch joined the Veiled Hand cult of the Burning Legion. However, Dreuger was the only councilman to be absent from these events, and it is unknown what happened to him.
Rosa is a human child located in Zul'Aman. She has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.

Rook Stonetoe was a pandaren found in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, and a member of the Golden Lotus. He was of "monstrous" size, with tree-trunk-sized arms and a coat that was pure white apart from a brown topknot and beard. Described as "loyal to a fault... a gentle friend, but also a ferocious enemy", Rook was known to fight with a giant, spike-adorned mace, and was a pandaren of few words. Rook was killed in the destruction of the vale caused by Garrosh Hellscream. Following his death, he can be encountered in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid as one of The Fallen Protectors.
Rolf Hartford was a human of the Stormwind Army. He was killed by murlocs.
Rota Surehide is an orc located at Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge.

Romuul is a draenei Holy paladin who was found by the Alliance champion repairing a defense crystal outside of Embaari Village. He eagerly joined the champion as a follower after the champion held off a pack of wolves that tried to attack him as he repaired the crystal. His Horde counterpart is Weaponsmith Na'Shra. He is seen assisting Alliance forces in the Gates of Tanaan. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.

Rory is a human ghost fisherman located at Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. He is normally invisible, and can only be seen by a player who has equipped the Spectral Essence item from the quest Kirtonos the Herald (quest), or a priest who has equipped The Eye of Divinity.

Rorin Rivershade is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Rory MacDuff is a Wildhammer dwarf blacksmith located at the Starfall Outpost in .
Roshene Stonewhisper is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Rorok Ironhide is an orc located at the Tannery in Frostwall. He initially provided tents but no longer does that.
Rot-Tooth is an orc located at the Rangari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle.
Rongar is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Roscoe is a human found in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
Ross O'Donovan is a human located in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Rosallas is a Lightforged draenei paladin and a commander in the Army of the Light. He's in charge of controlling and maintaining the rifts that the Army uses to conduct hit-and-run attacks on Argus.

Roland Hacksaw is a human located at the Carver's Harbor in Drustvar. He is considered one of the finest butchers in the region. Roland has been afflicted by the witches' curse and is constantly grinding meat - not caring if the meat is from a standard pig or a hexed human.
Ron Mahogany is a human located in Anchor's Away in Boralus.

Rosaline Madison is the human leader of the Outriggers located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound. She was later asked by Tandred Proudmoore to join his crew as his first mate, taking her Outriggers as members as well. As Tandred was chosen to captain the new ship that Kul Tiras was gifting to King Anduin Wrynn, Rosaline sailed with the ship to Stormwind Harbor.
Rosha Carrol is a human located at Eastpoint Station in Tiragarde Sound.

Ron Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley. He can also be found at various points in Boralus. He can dancing with an Off-Duty Cadet in the Barnacled Crab and hanging out with the Dock Rats in Anchor's Away.
Roselyn Gilbert is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Rolfe Braxton is a human fish vendor located on a boat that regularly docks at Hook Point in Boralus.
Rokk Stoneblood is an orc located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Rondi Lavadrinker is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Rosie Walker is a human located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Royal Historian Archesonus is a dwarf located in the High Seat in Ironforge. She wrote The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald and On Plagues, Curses, and Blights.
Rothos is a large green dragon that was corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare.
Rowan Helfgot is a human found in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Rousch is a dwarf found south of Dun Garok in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Roxa is a general goods vendor at Legion's Rest in Shimmering Expanse.

Roy was a member Creedy's gang of bounty hunters. Roy was the one who recognized Hemet Nesingwary when they encountered him in their hunt for three frostsaber cubs. He was killed by Hemet who was trying to save the cubs.
Royal Bodyguard is a human located at the Celestial Court in Timeless Isle. They are guarding Anduin Wrynn.
Royce Bigbeard is a dwarf found at the blacksmithing workshop just outside Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield.
Rotten Touch is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Feast of Souls (death knight artifact trait), Runic Tattoos and Plaguebearer traits.
Roughneck Gryphon Trainer is a human located in Tiragarde Sound.
Rugged Trapper's Shirt is the starting shirt for dwarf and night elf hunters.

Sir Rufus Montaine was a handsome red-haired human knight who died during the Battle of Theramore. Although he fought on the side of Daelin Proudmoore during the battle, "his honor was without stain" and he is remembered with honor as the one that taught Thrall "...about respect", and being "...a very good teacher" in the lesson. Thrall had first encountered Rufus at Durnholde Keep during one of Aedelas Blackmoore's gladiatorial tournaments. Rufus was with his mercenary father Morgan as spectators at the tournament. Rufus was impressed by Thrall and saw dignity in the orc. He wanted to know what his grandfather knew, when he fought the orcs in the Second War; the spirit of the orcs. His fath
Rueben Lauren is a human found in the Threads of Fate in Dalaran. He sells Bloodmage's Regalia items. During the purge of Dalaran, he was kneeling.
Rugok is an orc legacy :Justice Points vendor in Orgrimmar. He is found on the upper level of Grommash Hold from the back.
Rukh Zumtarg is an orc stable master located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Rune-Smith Kathorn is a a level 74-75 iron dwarf at Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills.
Rundok is an orc portal trainer located in front of the Arcane Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow and in the Pathfinder's Den of Orgrimmar.

Runda is an orc profession trainer located in Razor Hill in the Horde territory of Durotar. She teaches the apprentice level of all primary professions. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, she was busy constructing something. She appears at the Kosh'harg standing next to Tarshaw Jaggedscar and Burok.
Rumi Togglevolt is a dwarf. She is a graduate of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying and Gremlock's School of Caterers.

Rumelda Bloodslur is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. She is seen speaking with Noreen Trueflint.
Rulf is a human located in the Roughneck Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Ruknoz Greyfang is an orc located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
Rumbling Voice is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Might of the Vrykul, Toughness (warrior artifact trait), and Will to Survive (warrior artifact trait) traits.
Runecarver Sorn is a human located in the Shrine of the Storm.
Rungor is an orc trade goods vendor located at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest. He can be found outside the inn, on the south side of town.
Rushing Jade Wind is a Brewmaster and Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Special Delivery for Brewmaster.
Ruskan Goreblade was a level 92 Kor'kron Commander orc located at Northern Barrens.
Rupert was a human from Gilneas and who sold Lorna a couple of mastiff puppies. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Runic Strikes is the Blood death knight secondary stat attunement, focusing on Multistrike.
Rushing Vault was a Havoc demon hunter honor talent, available at rank 25.
Rushing Tiger Palm was a Windwalker monk honor talent, available at rank 10.
Runic Tattoos is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Rotten Touch (artifact trait), Portal to the Underworld and Scourge of Worlds traits.
Runic Chills is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Runefrost and Thronebreaker traits.

Russell Hayes was a human who lived in the town of Glenbrook Homestead before it was taken over. When his mother left to join the Heartsbane Coven, his father went searching for her and was sacrificed. Russell's current whereabouts are unknown but he was presumably killed.
Rupert Tellson is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Rushing Shear was a Vengeance demon hunter honor talent, available at honor rank 37.
Rushing Chaos was a Havoc demon hunter honor talent, available at honor rank 37.
Ruptured Viscera is an Unholy death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Magus of the Dead (death knight talent).
Runesmith Balehammer is a dwarf vendor found in the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Rybrad Coldbank is a dwarf weapon vendor located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh.

Ryona Blondbeard is a dwarf member of the Explorers' League. Despite his limited field experience, Ryona has distinguished himself as one of the most talented and useful of the Guild's staff at the Ironforge Guildhall. After becoming a prospector, Ryona was assigned to the quartermaster's shops and proved to be rather skilled at not only repairing equipment but improving it, from caltrop boots to field medical kits. When he was assigned to help create a system to help sort incoming field reports, he pressed on to create both an organizational system and corresponding racks of shelves for all reports and artifacts in the archives. Rutner Steelpick is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Frosthold in the Storm Peaks.

Corporal Rych was a human soldier of Northwatch Hold whose parents hailed from Kul Tiras. His father, before dying because of a flue, was a part of the Kul Tiras Irregulars and wielded a claymore. Rych's mother later died fighting the Burning Legion passing the weapon to her son. He used to work in a tavern named Mowbry's Tavern in Kul Tiras, where he cleared out the drunks there.

Rutger was an SI:7 agent assigned to spy on the Nathanos Blightcaller. During the course of this mission, he was discovered and ultimately killed. His skeleton is found at Marris Stead, along with his SI:7 Insignia.

Ry'el was a high elf ranger and a Farstrider lieutenant serving under Lor'themar Theron. He was stationed with Theron near Zul'Aman during the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas, and accompanied him to An'daroth. He was killed by a group of freshly-reanimated elven guardians, momentarily mistaking them for living elves.
Ryan Metcalf is a dead human located in Gloomshade Grove in .
Ryno Bloomfield is a human located in the Roiling Gardens in the Un'Goro Crater.

Ryon Quarvel is the leader of the Quarvel's Raiders. While searching for thunder lizards, he rode into the Barrens on a steam horse. After several hours, he encountered a pair of lizards and attacked them with his lance.
Ryan Fisher is a human located in Pinky's Groggery in Boralus.
Rusty Seafinch is a human located in the Baubles, Bobbers, & Beyond in Boralus.

Ruumbo is a presumed deity worshiped by the furbolgs of the Timbermaw tribe. Drizle and Ferli pretended to be him through his totem in Felwood in order to get revenge on the Deadwood tribe for killing their own and taking back their honey.
Ryen Levenson is a human located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Ruvin Stonegrinder is an orc located at Vakthros Range in the Azure Span.
Sabetta Ward is a human located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.
Sabersnout is a quilboar champion of the Bristleback tribe found in the Southern Barrens.
Sa'rah is a blood elf located at Challe's Home For Little Tykes in Nagrand.
Saber-Rider Isari is a night elf located at Domination Point in the Domination Point scenario.
Saatilu is a man'ari eredar located in the Nath'raxas Hold in Krokuun. She is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.
